HAProxy version 3.2.9-1ubuntu2.2 2026/06/19 - https://haproxy.org/
Status: long-term supported branch - will stop receiving fixes around Q2 2030.
Known bugs: http://www.haproxy.org/bugs/bugs-3.2.9.html
Running on: Linux 7.0.0-38-generic #38-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Sep  4 09:10:14 UTC 2026 x86_64
scratch_storage: private per-container disk-backed bind mounted at /tmp
limitations: HAProxy remains a host process; its cgroup memory is not isolated.
Caddy official release and p2pstream may use different Go patch releases.
p2pstream includes its full policy/recorder pipeline and an idle in-process agent fixture.
Proxy CPU affinity 0-3 comprises four logical CPUs on two physical cores.
Public H2 uses one client TCP connection for Caddy/candidate and two for HAProxy; HAProxy connection worker placement varies and does not saturate all four configured threads.
RSS and cgroup memory include different file-cache ownership effects; HAProxy is not cgroup-isolated and candidate contains an idle real-agent fixture.
Four tiny-response direct cells do not establish parity for upload, streaming, tunnel paths, or production capacity.
cpu_coordination: Root exclusively owned benchmark CPU; Astra and both workers directly acknowledged source-only before this run; worker test handoff followed completion.
sanitization: Local build paths replaced with <clean-archive> or <download>; loopback ports and relative fixture paths retained; no generated key/certificate contents included.
